summary: Build an ISO 22000 food safety management system that passes audits and controls hazards. Enroll in this 5-day practical training.
lede: Food safety management system (FSMS) training helps food safety, quality, and production professionals develop and maintain an ISO 22000-based system. It covers interpreting requirements, mapping prerequisite programs, analyzing hazards and selecting CCP or OPRP controls, and planning monitoring, verification, and internal audits to connect day-to-day food safety practices with documented system processes.
audienceIntro: This ISO 22000 food safety management systems training is designed for professionals who already work with food safety controls and need to operationalize the ISO 22000 standard across their processes and teams.
audience: Internal Auditor with a focus on food
modules: Context, Leadership, and Planning in ISO 22000
HACCP Studies and Hazard Analysis under ISO 22000
prerequisites: This is an intermediate-level ISO 22000 food safety management systems course. You should already have basic exposure to food safety or quality management in a production, catering, distribution, or retail environment. Prior knowledge of HACCP concepts, core food hazards (biological, chemical, physical, allergenic), and basic documentation practices is strongly recommended. No coding or advanced IT skills are required, but you should be comfortable working with spreadsheets and digital forms for monitoring and verification records. The course teaches ISO 22000 and supporting concepts at operational application level, with some implementation planning, but it does not replace full consultant-level implementation projects. Bringing examples of your current FSMS documents (procedures, HACCP plans, forms) is encouraged for use in exercises, subject to your organization’s confidentiality policies.
